title: Rule CSV row
description: One row of a rules CSV, after the validator parses the cells: empty cells become null, limit_minutes becomes an integer, schedule (JSON text in the CSV) becomes an object or null. A null schedule means always in force. Street and cross streets come from the segment, not the row.

city_id.description: Added by the build script; optional in the CSV.

side.description: Left or right when facing along the segment's direction: first to last coordinate of its line in segments.geojson. Never a compass direction.

type.description: Restrictions only. The no-stopping layer is these rows filtered by type.

permit_code.description: Timed parking permit code, or the permit exception on a restriction.

color_key.description: Key into the city's curb color config.
